title: chargehand run summary, v1
description: One row of a run list (ADR 0039): enough to show a run's state, cost and pull request without reading its result.

parent_run_id.description: Set when a driven session started this run (its research and review calls).

task_ref.description: The tracker item id or task id the run was started for.

usd.description: Priced by the orchestrator's table; null when the cost is unknown or the credential is not priced.

error_code.description: result/v1's error.code of a failed run.
